claims.text: The transaction state topic (__transaction_state) defaults to 50 partitions to enable horizontal scaling of transaction coordinators across the cluster. Transactional IDs are assigned to coordinator brokers by hashing the ID modulo the partition count; with 50 partitions, transaction coordination can be distributed across up to 50 brokers in parallel, preventing any single broker from becoming a bottleneck. A smaller number would serialize coordination through fewer coordinators, limiting throughput and fault tolerance. The value 50 provides sufficient concurrency for most production deployments without incurring the overhead (memory, disk segments, metadata management) associated with significantly larger partition counts. This setting should be established at cluster initialization and not changed afterward.
